review_scope: Targeted review of PERSONALIZED_REVIEW.md and personalized_review_v1.json against accepted v2 design; independent scalar/rational references, not production behavior or investment outcomes.

independent_facts.finding: Ten unique profile/fee upstream rows map to at most ten fixed-class cases. Null upstream assignments remain upstream_referral with no simulation, no synthetic bills fallback and original reasons. Invalid assignment/screen/hash is a failed input, never a referral.

Each non-null assignment keeps its fee/mode/fold prior and all other v2 parameters; only generic threshold becomes own tolerance; evaluation stops at own H with 120 fresh scenarios. Full other-fold training rows remain fixed, not an evaluated-path refit.

Both p90-loss <= tolerance and p10-real-CAGR >= 0 are rerun unrounded and inclusively. Risk-only, power-only and both failures null recommended_class, retain proposed_class and refer without another class search. Strict loss>tolerance count is distinct.

Running maximum drawdown observes initial, post-fee and year-end real wealth through t-1. Equality triggers next-review latch, a last-year crossing does not invent H+1, pending keeps exact component dollars and zero fee while earning returns.
Primary .0025 and .005 class assignments are independent upstream counterfactual records. Different classes are reportable but cannot overwrite primary or certify robustness of one strategy.

POLICY_ANALYSIS generic Balanced H30/25% same-primary-mode robustness check remains independent: at .005 retain primary-selected mode against its original controls. Adaptive needs context AND cost; context needs cost. Primary balanced_cost means no added complexity selected, not automatic absolute suitability.

All/no/partial assignments retain ten root summary rows. Executed ledger and decision counts each =120*sum(assigned H); metrics=120*assigned_count; per-case summary=1; fixed-mode score count=non-human-review decision count, maximum ledger count. All assigned maxima 19440/19440/1200; no assignments 0/0/0. Partial A-primary/B-doubled/D-primary gives 5400/5400/360.

B is H15,25%,medium. Identical fixed mode/fee/fold prior and fresh state require exact generic H15 ledger/decision/score prefix and derived metrics, with no later deployment/latch leakage. Scalar prefix identity is checked here; absent policy code is not certified.

chief_clarifications.item: source_version_at_drafting is historical provenance, not an executable source pin. Future immutable configuration must bind exact accepted generic analysis/assignment files and code/calibration hashes, as required by the prose; none is fabricated here.

PERSONALIZED_REVIEW inherits the independent generic Balanced same-primary-mode sensitivity test from POLICY_ANALYSIS/v2. A future report must retain that result separately; ten personalized assignments do not replace it.

The row-count fixture uses personalized denominator=0 for not-run referrals and null personalized outcome statistics/flags, with original upstream reasons/hash retained. A future schema should spell out this count convention; it must never divide by zero or import a generic 120-observation statistic as a personalized outcome.

reference_assumptions: Scalar wealth events and holdings are deliberately constructed, not generated by a policy. The early fee fixture uses an all-equity accounting transfer solely to show post-fee threshold timing; it is not a newly permitted target.

Shape fixtures assign illustrative eligible Conservative classes and force one final suspended review per scenario only to count score rows. Their zero numeric placeholders demonstrate presence/null semantics, not successful investment outcomes.
Primary/counterfactual illustrative different-class records are logically possible for an eligible profile (e.g. B), not an observed recommendation.

Exact Fraction arithmetic governs boundaries and accounting; derived floating CAGR/sample-standard-deviation checks use abs 1e-9 and rel 1e-10. Saved derived floating CAGR permits only that tolerance; counts, booleans, rational values, policy thresholds, identities and artifact hashes compare exactly.
scope_limits: No competition CSV opened, actual policy/helper executed, original design rereviewed, implementation or K1 fix certified, packages installed, final outcomes accessed, or trading authorized.
Prior SOL-013 corrected design approve and historical kernel changes_required remain distinct; K1 is reviewed elsewhere.

Synthetic reference evidence cannot establish performance, benefit, personalized loss cap or freeze/final authorization. Future source, implementation, production evidence and independent chief/HY3 acceptance remain separate.
